text:
Situation: DOBUTamine hydrochloride has been on FDA's shortage list since 2017-11-06 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 2.4 days on hand across two presentations (16 units of 100mg/250mL bags at 3.1 days; 9 units of 12.5mg/mL 20mL vials at 1.7 days). Corvale General holds 21 days on hand and can spare 122 units while retaining a two-week supply. Corvale Lakeside holds 13.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2017-11-06; status is current as of 2026-10-21. Our Baxter-labeled product (NDC 00338107702) is manufactured at Baxter Healthcare Corporation FEI 1416980, inspected 2026-04-02, classified OAI. Our Hospira-labeled product (NDC 00409234401) is made at Hospira FEI 1925262, last inspected 2025-01-17, classified VAI.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest, lowest-risk path to stabilize Corvale East without new procurement or concentration changes.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 122 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst — approved by Buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — approved by Buyer.
4. Use Hospira 12.5 mg/mL alternate concentration — pharmacist verification required; approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-03-20.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
